tables.title: Glossary
tables.text: Table 329, "Glossary", in section 39.1 (DCMIPP introduction) on page 1816. Columns: Item, Definition. 16 data row(s).

rows: Alpha component, used to define transparency, opaque = 0xFF, for example ARGB.

In ISP domain: acronym for AE-AF-AWB, algorithms automatically correcting pictures:
–AE: automatic exposure control (adapts exposure or sensibility of sensor)
–AF: automatic focus control (adapts the focus)
–AWB: automatic white balance (adapts the color tones to have a white balance).

Bits per component (for example, RGB565 has five bits for the red component, hence 
5 bpc)
Bits per pixel (for example, RGB565 has 16 bits per pixel, hence 16 bpp)
®Camera serial interface, and its latest standard by MIPI, the CSI-2 v1.3 (and v2.0)

Data type, used in the CSI-2 standard. The data type is a concept similar to the pixel 
format, but adds support for other data like the byte format.

Interlaced video: the field with odd lines is transmitted first, followed, after the last odd 
line, by the field with even lines. The two fields are thus consecutive but exclusive.

Interleaved packets, applies to CSI-2: two groups of packets transmitted by the sensor 
can be emitted mixed, as a packet granularity.

Image signal processing: algorithms that retune the sensor output (through correction 
of pixels, demosaicing, lens-correction, light/contrast correction) to build a good quality 
picture.
Neural network processing engine (also known as NN, neural network).

Defines in how many sub-buffers a pixel buffer is split into: 1 (coplanar), 2 (semi-
planar), 3 (full planar).
Region of interest (pixel box surrounding the region of interest)

Virtual channel, used in the CSI-2 standard, makes it possible to simultaneously 
transmit up to four parallel flows (in CSI-2 v1.3) or more (in CSI-2 v2.0).
Pixel format, YUV color reference, all three components (Y, U, V) given per pixel.
Pixel format, YUV color reference, chroma component (U, V) sub-sampled 1/2 in X
